heading: INT. DRAINED SWIMMING POOL - TABLE TENNIS HALL - DAY

units.text: INT. DRAINED SWIMMING POOL - TABLE TENNIS HALL - DAY
A municipal pool, long since emptied, its blue tiles chipped to the colour of old teeth.
Two green tables stand in the deep end where the water once was.
Dust turns in a shaft of light from a skylight.
DEZ OKAFOR (late 20s, loose-limbed, a towel around his neck) bounces the little white ball on his paddle, humming.
Across the table, LIN HUA (teens, tight ponytail, fierce eyes) waits, perfectly still.
In the shallow end bleachers, GRANDPA TSUBASA (80s, folded in a cardigan) eats tangerine segments.
At the net post, REFEREE BARNABY (60s, clipboard, whistle) checks his watch with a priest's solemnity.
Match point, Lin. Take your time.
units.name: BARNABY

units.text: Lin, nobody's rushing you. We could be at a picnic.
units.name: DEZ

units.text: Don't talk to me like I'm eight, Dez.
units.name: LIN

units.text: Wouldn't dream of it.
units.name: DEZ

units.text: He serves, soft and lazy.
Lin returns it just as soft.
The rally floats back and forth, almost tender, ball ticking in the quiet like a slow clock.
Easy, Lin-chan. Easy.
units.name: TSUBASA

units.text: Your grandfather's a good coach.
units.name: DEZ

units.text: Why are you letting me win?
units.name: LIN

units.text: I'm not letting you.
units.name: DEZ

units.text: You are. You've dropped four easy balls in a row.
units.name: ^LIN

units.text: Dez mishits on purpose.
The ball skitters into the deep corner.
The hall holds its breath.
Barnaby lowers his clipboard and looks, very slowly, at Tsubasa.
The old man stops chewing.
Barnaby. Tell her about the envelope.
units.name: TSUBASA
